headline: News this morning, 1/10: Overnight interbank interest rate falls to near 0%
summary: Vietnam's overnight interbank interest rate fell to near 0%, according to a daily news digest from Ho Chi Minh City. The digest also covered business debt reviews and social insurance evasion.
why: The overnight interbank rate is the cost banks pay to borrow short-term from each other, and it signals liquidity conditions in the banking system.
